systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Receipt-only mode performs no publication. Review mode uses the existing Original publication/activation command with exact version, review hash, request ID and both confirmations; package setup uses its separate Original owner.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Saving the setup grants no access or activation. Explicit admitted publication promotes and activates the reviewed Native Agent without dispatching a run or granting arbitrary external effects. Reading its receipt has no such effect.
systemWork.asyncWork: Principal/company/draft-keyed no-store queries; immediate hide on authority events; frozen request/body/version retry; late acknowledgements cannot restore private content after revocation. V9 account observation rechecks on return inside the ordinary 30-second freshness window, without restarting reads for nested observers. Same-turn QueryClient fetch guards and authority epochs fence Native transport and late acknowledgements.
systemWork.receipt: Current Original company/draft/Agent/request-bound published version and package provenance. Keep the same publication instance across review to receipt and re-read the Original under current authority. A reload preserves command identity, never inferred success or automatic replay.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain that no currently customer-qualified capabilities are available; do not substitute an internal evaluation package.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Hide retained results immediately on authority changes and re-read the native owner; withdrawn exact-version links are unavailable.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Announce only the server-confirmed canonical result. First value additionally requires independently verified native artifact/run binding.

navigation.back: Back to agents or the capability catalog via native links.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Saved setups resume through canonical draft links; authored content is not persisted in browser storage.
navigation.resume: Read the current creator-private proposal and its pinned package version. No browser content persistence.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Native links, labeled inputs, select controls and semantic fieldsets; pending reconciliation disables editing. Standard Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.
